title: Color Eraser (TextAndFormat)

scenarios.title: Color Eraser applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Color Eraser (BtnTransparentColor) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Transparent Color pixel rule (tolerance limit, alpha gate, inclusive boundary) pinned host-free
scenarios.expected: The production pixel rule pins: the squared Cartesian limit follows 3*255^2*tolerance^2 and clamps the tolerance into 0..1; at zero tolerance only exact RGB matches become transparent; already transparent pixels (alpha 0) are never touched; the distance boundary is inclusive exactly as the production float arithmetic computes it (distSq == limit transparent, one unit beyond stays opaque); full tolerance makes every opaque pixel transparent. TransparentColorWindow delegates both the limit and the per-pixel decision to this policy (single production implementation).
